description.value: The Vault is a 100% Canadian-owned, locally cherished restaurant that has served Downtown Historic Cloverdale for over 18 years, offering globally inspired comfort dishes under Chef Thomas Gilbert. Part of the Pacific Northcoast Restaurant Group, the restaurant features live music on weekend evenings and can host special events and large parties for up to 90 guests.
